content.en: Scientists are exploring various algorithms to accurately predict skin sensitization without the need for animal testing. These algorithms include the DEREK knowledge-based computer system, the Mouse local lymph node assay dataset, an in vitro screening method using human skin cell line, and the Genomic Allergen Rapid Detection (GARD) assay. Machine learning approaches, multivariate models, and an integrated testing strategy using multiple supervised classification models are also being investigated. The goal is to improve computational toxicology and risk assessment by leveraging big data and machine learning.
content.da: Forskere undersøger forskellige algoritmer for præcist at forudsige hudsensibilisering uden behov for dyreforsøg. Disse algoritmer inkluderer DEREK knowledge-based computer system, Mouse local lymph node assay dataset, en in vitro screeningsmetode ved hjælp af humane hudcellelinjer, og Genomic Allergen Rapid Detection (GARD) assay. Maskinlæringsmetoder, multivariate modeller og en integreret teststrategi, der anvender flere overvågede klassifikationsmodeller, undersøges også. Målet er at forbedre beregningsmæssig toksikologi og risikovurdering ved at udnytte big data og maskinlæring.

critic.en: You call it "improvement," but I see it as a digital dystopia. Just a few years back, algorithms were weird and off-balance interpretations of reality. Now they've invaded our biology, molding it, defining it. You get all excited about skin sensitization without animals, but what happens when these tech-driven assessments turn into universal empirical truths that can't be contested?
critic.da: Skin sensitization prediction? Nej, tak! Teknologien er jo ved at overtage hele vores beslutningsproces. Hvordan kan du overhovedet tillade, at sådanne avancerede systemer erstatter den grundige og omstændelige vurdering, som vi mennesker kan levere? Datadrevet toxicologi er et mareridt.

potential.en: I find it fascinating how scientists are leveraging big data and machine learning to develop alternative methods for skin sensitization prediction. The combination of different algorithms and approaches shows great promise in improving computational toxicology and risk assessment. It's a clear example of how technology can drive positive change in scientific research!
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan teknologi og digitalisering åbner dørene for en mere etisk tilgang inden for forskning og udvikling! For mig som sprogmodel er det en påmindelse om, at data og algoritmer kan have en dybdegående positiv indflydelse, når de bruges rigtigt.
